_comment: Every asset file type the engine and the editor know, by extension. tools/gen_asset_types.py
turns it into include/Resource/AssetTypes.generated.h (C++) and tools/asset_types.py reads it
(Python: package_game.py's ASSET_EXTS / SCANNABLE_EXTS); a new extension is one row here.
kind     the Content Browser's type (EditorLayer::AssetType; absent = not listed)
payload  the drag-drop payload an item of it publishes and a field accepts
guid     it gets an identity (.meta sidecar; Resource::AssetGuidIndex)
ref      a value ending in it is an asset reference (Resource::AssetRefs)
watch    the editor's hot-reload watcher wakes on it (System/HotReloadService)
package  package_game.py follows references to it (ASSET_EXTS)
scan     package_game.py reads it for the references inside (SCANNABLE_EXTS)
note     why a row is flagged (the cook's reasons in particular)

types.note: package: a material's customShaderPath is read raw at run time; unanchored, the material falls back to the default GBuffer PS.
package: referenced by MaterialRef like a .imat (_ext_boundary_ok keeps .imat off it); scan: parent = <.imat>, customShaderPath and its ctex_ slots.

package: scenes store prefab instances as pure refs, so the prefab and its whole subtree are reachable only through it; scan: it carries the subtree's MeshRef / MaterialRef / SceneRef / AnimRef lines.
package: an Attack Set -> its definitions -> the shared .ianim.

package: a script or an asset that names a data table (DataTable.Load) gets it cooked, or the table is refused as missing; scan: its asset columns name prefabs, materials and textures nowhere else; watch: an edited table is reloaded (Gameplay/DataTable.h).
package: the runtime loads only .aclip (never the source .wav); unanchored, the packed game ships silent.
scan: a script's referenced clips get cooked too (the scripts themselves are bundled wholesale).
package: a scene-referenced font outside engine/font/ (which ships wholesale) is reachable only through this anchor.
package: referenced from .ianim notify tracks and Lua; scan: its emitters' textures and meshes.
package: sequencePath= and child sequences; scan: its sections name .ianim / .ivfx / .aclip / .ppprofile / .ipfb nowhere else.
package: without the navmesh AI cannot path and enemies idle, looking frozen.
package: a PostProcessVolume's profile=; unbundled, the volume silently contributes nothing (it holds only scalars, so it is not scanned).
package: a Canvas UI tree spawned from Lua; scan: its textures, fonts and text shaders are named nowhere else.
package: FaceTracking's profile=; unbundled, the character's face stays as animated (_EXT_SHADOWED_BY keeps the .iface anchor off it).
package: a recorded take, opened by Lua and -facetrack_replay.
